# `silk/platform/windows/environment`

<!-- Generated by silk doc-reference. Do not edit by hand. -->

Delimiter rules for Windows UTF-16 environment entries.

## When to use
Use `EnvironmentEntry.separator` on one entry without its NUL terminator. Windows host-input
capture uses it to preserve hidden drive entries such as `=C:=C:\work`.

Import as `EnvironmentEntry` with `import silk.platform.windows.environment { EnvironmentEntry }`.

Public declarations: 1.

<a id="EnvironmentEntry.impl.separator"></a>

### Associated function `separator`

```silk
pub fn separator(units: &[u16]) -> Option<usize>
```

Returns the first equals sign after index zero, or an absent option for a malformed entry.

#### Details

The prefix is the name and the suffix is the value. A leading equals sign belongs to the name,
so `=C:=C:\work` has name `=C:`. Empty values are accepted; embedded NUL is rejected.
